scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello! I recently submitted a loan application for a home improvement project, and I'm checking in on the status. Could you please tell me if my application is still pending, approved, or denied? And what is the current loan term that was approved?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application, LOAN-00836, has been processed. The action taken on your application is that the loan has been originated, which means it has been approved and finalized. The approved loan term is 240 months.

dialogue.user: I'm glad to hear that my application was approved. A 240-month term is what I was expecting, so that's good. Can you please tell me what my interest rate is for this loan? And what are the total costs associated with the loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 10.490%. Unfortunately, the record does not show the total loan costs. If you have any other questions or need further clarification on any aspect of your loan, feel free to ask.

dialogue.user: A 10.490% interest rate seems a bit higher than I was hoping for, but I can work with it. I do have another question - are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan that I should be aware of? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA. Additionally, your loan does not have negative amortization features. As for your question about the loan being sold, the record indicates that the purchaser type is not applicable, which means the loan was not sold to another institution after origination.

dialogue.user: appreciate you know about the HOEPA lack of negative amortization features. That helps to give me a clearer picture of the loan. With my being sold to another institution, I feel a bit more secure. One - what does my debt-to-income ratio look like for this application, and is there any additional information that know about my loan product?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is between 30% and 36%. The loan product type is Conventional: Subordinate Lien, and the loan purpose is for a home improvement project, which aligns with your initial application. If you have any further questions or concerns, I'm here to help.

dialogue.user:
Having a debt-to-income ratio between 30% and 36% is something I can manage. I appreciate your help in clarifying the details of my loan. I think I have all the information I need. You have been very helpful and professional. 
<Satisfied> 
I am satisfied with the interaction because the agent was competent, courteous, and provided clear and timely information about my loan application.
